# BOOT Q3 2026 Earnings Call
## Summary
Boot Barn Holdings Inc. reported robust third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, with revenue increasing 16% year-over-year to $706 million, driven by strong same-store sales growth and new store expansion. Consolidated same-store sales grew 5.7%, comprising a 3.7% increase in brick-and-mortar stores and a 19.6% surge in e-commerce.
Earnings per diluted share reached $2.79, up from $2.43 in the prior year, with a 26% increase when excluding a one-time benefit related to the former CEO's resignation in 2025. Gross profit rose 18% to $281 million, with the gross profit rate expanding 60 basis points to 39.9%, supported by a 110 basis point improvement in merchandise margin.
## Financial Performance
- **SG&A Expenses**: $166 million (23.6% of sales), leveraging 40 bps YoY excluding one-time items
- **Operating Income**: $115 million (16.3% of sales), leveraging 100 bps YoY excluding one-time items
- **EPS**: $2.79 diluted, up from $2.43 YoY; up 26% excluding prior-year benefit

- EPS: $1.45
- **Full-Year Fiscal 2026 (raised)**:
  - Total sales: $2.25 billion (+18% YoY)
  - Same-store sales: +7% (stores +6%, e-commerce +15%)
  - Merchandise margin: ~50.8% of sales (+70 bps YoY)
  - Gross profit: ~38% of sales
We expect gross profit to be approximately 36.1% of sales, which includes 50 basis points of deleverage in buying, occupancy, and distribution center costs. Our income from operations is expected to be $59 million or 11.1% of sales.

We expect earnings per diluted share to be $1.45. Based on our year-to-date performance and fourth quarter outlook, we are raising our full-year guidance.
